fa-accept-required: You must accept the terms to sign.
fa-certificate-footer: This certificate is part of the sealed copy of the document. The SHA-256 fingerprint of the sealed copy, which cannot be included in itself, can be checked on the public verification page with each signer's code. Signatures are simple electronic signatures with evidence; they are not qualified electronic signatures.
fa-certificate-intro: Certificate of the electronic signatures of the document, generated on %date%, with each signer's data, the SHA-256 fingerprints of the document they saw and the log of everything that happened.
fa-check-file-help: Upload the signed PDF to find out whether it is exactly the sealed copy. The file is not stored: only its fingerprint is computed.
fa-code-not-found: There is no signature with that code.
fa-contract-email-help: Empty: the contact or customer email.
fa-contract-text-help: Copy of the template text. It can be adapted until someone signs; then it is locked.
fa-draw-help: Sign with your mouse, finger or stylus inside the box.
fa-email-unknown: %email% does not belong to any customer, supplier or contact.
fa-emails-help: Separated by commas, spaces or line breaks. Each one gets its own contract.
fa-file-differs: The PDF does NOT match any sealed copy of this document.
fa-file-error: The file could not be saved.
fa-file-matches: The PDF matches: it is the sealed copy, unchanged.
fa-identity-required: Type your name and your ID number.
fa-invalid-link: The link is not valid or the document is no longer available.
fa-legal-default: I have read the document and I agree. By signing I declare that the data I entered is true and that this electronic signature is equivalent to my handwritten signature.
fa-logo-help: Image at the top of the contract.
fa-mail-copy-text: Thank you for signing. Attached is the sealed copy of the document. Its verification code is %code%.
fa-mail-expires: The link will be available until %date%.
fa-mail-invite-text: We are sending you "%doc%" to review and sign. Press the button to view and sign it from any device, without registering.
fa-mail-otp-text: This is the code to sign "%doc%". It expires in %minutes% minutes. If you did not ask to sign this document, ignore this message.
fa-mail-reminder-text: This is a reminder that "%doc%" is still awaiting your signature.
fa-message-help: Default invitation text. Empty: a standard text.
fa-no-requests: No signatures yet. Request one remotely or sign right here.
fa-otp-expired: The code has expired. Ask for a new one.
fa-otp-help: Ask the signer for a code sent to their email before signing.
fa-otp-intro: To sign, confirm you are the recipient: we will send a 6-digit code to %email%.
fa-otp-label: Ask for an email code before signing
fa-otp-needs-email: An email is needed to ask for a code.
fa-otp-ok: Correct code. You can sign now.
fa-otp-required: The email code must be verified before signing.
fa-otp-too-many: Too many attempts. Ask for a new code.
fa-otp-wait: Wait %seconds% seconds to ask for another code.
fa-pdf-error: The PDF could not be generated: %error%
fa-public-cancelled: This signature request has been cancelled.
fa-public-expired: The deadline to sign this document has passed. Contact whoever sent it to you.
fa-public-rejected: You declined to sign this document.
fa-public-signed: Document signed. You can download your sealed copy.
fa-reject: I do not want to sign
fa-reject-confirm: Are you sure you do not want to sign this document?
fa-reject-reason: Why are you not signing it?
fa-rejected-ok: We have notified that you will not sign the document.
fa-request-closed: This request can no longer change: it is signed, declined, cancelled or expired.
fa-send-invite-now: Send the invitation by email now
fa-settings-copy-help: When signing, the signer receives the sealed PDF by email.
fa-settings-notify-help: The user who created the request gets an email when it is signed or declined.
fa-settings-otp-help: Checked by default in new requests.
fa-settings-print-help: Print the signatures at the foot of estimate, order, delivery note and invoice PDFs.
fa-settings-reminder-days-help: 0: do not send reminders. Requires the FacturaScripts cron.
fa-settings-valid-days-help: Days the link accepts the signature. 0: never expires.
fa-signature-invalid: The signature image is not valid.
fa-signed-cannot-delete: A completed signature cannot be deleted.
fa-signed-text-locked: Someone has already signed: the text cannot be changed.
fa-template-no-signatures: The template does not include {{firmas}}: signatures will be added at the end of the contract.
fa-template-text-help: Use the variables from the Variables tab. Put {{firmas}} where the signatures must go.
fa-upload-invalid: Upload a PDF smaller than 20 MB.
fa-variables-help: These variables are replaced with the contract data when it is shown and printed:
fa-variables-signatures-help: {{firmas}} shows the signature blocks of all signers and {{firma_empresa}} the company signature image chosen in the template.
